verdict: Watched source/native press and state-layer pairs at normal speed; user reports matching native press, overlap, release, hover, drag, focus, interruption and reduced-motion finish where applicable.

observations.note: The native press starts from the pinned bounded and unbounded source origins; hover state begins at zero opacity.
A second press overlaps the first release while the state layer can retarget into drag.
The state layer interrupts an early drag and reverses toward rest; the press layer retains its separate exit.
The state layer finishes its pinned drag exit; reduced motion paints its terminal state without interpolation.
